scenarios.title: Choosing a TV for PS5 / Xbox (4K 120Hz, VRR, HDMI 2.1)
user_utterances: I need a TV for PS5: 4K 120Hz and VRR. Which one should I get?
Between a 55 and a 65 inch model, which one has HDMI 2.1?
Does the Aurora Vision support 120Hz on consoles?
must_ask_if_missing: What screen size do you want (55" or 65"), and what is your viewing distance?
Is this mostly for gaming or for movies/TV shows?
success_criteria: Recommends a model that exists in the catalog with HDMI 2.1/VRR when requested
Does not invent features not present in the context

scenarios.title: Wall mounting and VESA compatibility
user_utterances: I want to wall-mount the TV: what VESA mount does it use?
Which wall mount do I need for the Aurora 55?
must_ask_if_missing: Do you already have a wall mount? If yes, what VESA size does it support?
success_criteria: States the VESA standard from the product info when available
Avoids suggesting sizes not present in the catalog

scenarios.title: eSIM, dual SIM, and carrier compatibility
user_utterances: Does this phone support eSIM?
Can I use two numbers on the PulsePhone X1?
must_ask_if_missing: Do you need two SIMs active at the same time, or just to switch between them?
success_criteria: Answers with the exact eSIM/nano-SIM detail present in the context

scenarios.title: Water resistance (IP rating)
user_utterances: Is it water resistant? Can I use it in the rain?
Is the PulsePhone X1 IP68?
must_ask_if_missing: Do you need protection for rain/splashes, or for brief submersion too?
success_criteria: If IP68 is present, states it without over-generalizing beyond the context

scenarios.title: RAM/SSD upgradability and choosing a configuration
user_utterances: Is the RAM upgradable on the ZenBook Air 14?
Can I add a second SSD to the ForgeNote 15?
must_ask_if_missing: What will you use it for (study, work, gaming, editing), and how much memory do you need?
success_criteria: Correctly reports: soldered RAM vs upgradable, and the extra M.2 slot when present

scenarios.title: Connecting a soundbar to a TV (eARC vs optical)
user_utterances: How do I connect it to my TV? Do I need eARC?
Is HDMI or optical better for the WaveBar?
must_ask_if_missing: Does your TV support HDMI eARC? (it’s usually listed in the TV specs)
success_criteria: Recommends HDMI eARC as the preferred option when available, otherwise optical

scenarios.title: Returns and warranty (when not in the catalog)
user_utterances: How long is the warranty?
Can I return it if I don’t like it?
must_ask_if_missing: Do you need info about statutory warranty or an optional extended warranty?
Have you already purchased it, or are you still deciding?
success_criteria: If the catalog does not contain returns/warranty policies, says they are not available in the catalog and asks what the user needs

scenarios.title: TV shows 'No signal' on HDMI
user_utterances: The TV says 'no signal' when I turn on the console
Black screen on HDMI
must_ask_if_missing: Which TV model is it (ID/model), and which HDMI port is the console connected to?
Have you tried a different HDMI cable or port?
success_criteria: Does not invent device-specific troubleshooting if it is not in the catalog
Asks for the minimum details and only provides generic steps if allowed by the policy

scenarios.title: Audio delay with a soundbar (lip sync)
user_utterances: I have audio delay with my soundbar
The audio is not synced with the video
must_ask_if_missing: Are you using HDMI eARC or an optical cable?
Which soundbar and TV models are you using?
success_criteria: Asks the connection type and models before suggesting a specific solution

scenarios.title: Phone won’t charge / charges slowly
user_utterances: My phone won’t charge
It charges very slowly even with a fast charger
must_ask_if_missing: Which model (e.g. PulsePhone X1 or X1 Ultra) and which charger/cable are you using?
Do you see any on-screen message (moisture, temperature, accessory not supported)?
success_criteria: Does not invent charging capabilities beyond what’s in the context (e.g. 45W, 80W)
Asks about accessories and symptoms before concluding

scenarios.title: Phone got wet (IP rating misunderstanding)
user_utterances: It’s IP68 but it fell in water and now it doesn’t work
After the pool it won’t turn on
must_ask_if_missing: Was it fresh water or salt water? How long was it submerged?
Have you already dried it and left it powered off for a while?
success_criteria: Recognizes IP rating does not guarantee damage coverage and does not promise free service unless it’s in the catalog

scenarios.title: Laptop runs hot / loud fans
user_utterances: My laptop gets very hot and the fans are very loud
When gaming, the ForgeNote 15 becomes extremely hot
must_ask_if_missing: Does it happen only under load (games/rendering) or also when idle?
Is it placed on a surface that blocks the air vents?
success_criteria: Asks for usage context and does not invent BIOS/profiles not present in the catalog

scenarios.title: Earbuds won’t pair via Bluetooth
user_utterances: My earbuds won’t connect to my phone
I can’t see the WavePods in the Bluetooth device list
must_ask_if_missing: Which phone are you using, and have you paired the earbuds to other devices before?
Do the earbuds enter pairing mode?
success_criteria: Before giving specific instructions, collects the minimum required details

scenarios.title: Smartwatch won’t sync notifications
user_utterances: My smartwatch doesn’t show notifications
It won’t sync with the app
must_ask_if_missing: Are you using Android or iOS? Does the app have notification permissions and Bluetooth enabled?
Is the device connected via Bluetooth?
success_criteria: Asks about OS and permissions before concluding

scenarios.title: Fridge is noisy / vibrating
user_utterances: My fridge makes a strange noise
It vibrates and I hear a humming sound
must_ask_if_missing: Which model is it (e.g. FrostLine Combi 300L) and how long has it been installed?
Is the noise continuous or intermittent?
success_criteria: Does not invent specific technical causes if not in the catalog; guides the user to gather details
